posts.zh:
free-vision-skill 已收录到 DeepSeek Harness Plugin Store。基于 macOS Vision Framework 的全本地识图插件：`ocr_image`（文字提取，表格结构+坐标）与 `view_image`（场景/人脸/二维码）；web 输入框可直接粘贴多张图片，图片永不离开你的 Mac。

查看来源与安装：https://deeplugin.store/plugins/deeplugin-bdfceda13de3ecd7d88c.html
posts.en:
free-vision-skill is now listed on the DeepSeek Harness Plugin Store. Fully-local image understanding & OCR via macOS Vision Framework: `ocr_image` (text, table layout + coordinates) and `view_image` (scene, faces, QR) — paste multiple images into the web input box or pass path/URL/base64; images never leave your Mac.

Source and install details: https://deeplugin.store/plugins/deeplugin-bdfceda13de3ecd7d88c.html
